name: print-social-black-history-month-infographic-green-orange-black
title: 'Black History Month' infographic with green and orange fact blocks, a fist-in-Africa icon and a closing quote
whatItIs: A black-bordered square infographic with a serif 'BLACK HISTORY MONTH' title, an intro line, and stacked green/orange/yellow blocks covering Movements and Activism (with a raised-fist-shaped Africa icon), a '90% Labor' stat, an Agriculture vs Other Industries Venn diagram, an 1808 date callout, and a closing quote from A. Philip Randolph.
whatItMeans: Respectful and informative; mixing icon, stat and quote formats keeps a history lesson visually varied within one strict palette.
techniques: Combine icon, stat, diagram and quote blocks in one infographic.
Use a symbolic icon (fist-shaped continent) to open the topic.
Close with a sourced historical quote for weight.

vocabulary.definition: An icon whose shape itself carries meaning.
Overlapping circles showing proportion or relationship.
